# Electric Literature

> A digital literary magazine publishing fiction, poetry, interviews, and curated reading lists from contemporary and established writers.

Electric Literature is an online literary magazine dedicated to showcasing diverse voices in fiction, poetry, and creative nonfiction. The publication features author interviews, book reviews, reading recommendations, and cover reveals alongside original literary work.

## Key Topics

- Fiction
- Poetry
- Literary interviews
- Book reviews
- Reading lists
- Personal narrative
- Cover reveals
- Contemporary literature
- Recommended reading
- Literary magazine

- [Home - Electric Literature](https://electricliterature.com): Electric Literature homepage featuring fiction, poetry, interviews, and literary content
